lessons.reason: ready-for-review connector GraphQL schema failure
lessons.rootCause: the connector path used to mutate draft state was not reliable for this repository flow
lessons.fix: replace the failed draft with a fresh ready PR on the exact tested head

lessons.reason: GitHub Actions direct Notion state writeback returned 404 after public verification succeeded
lessons.rootCause: GitHub Actions used an unproven Notion write path while Make already owned a proven connection
lessons.fix: keep GitHub verification read-only and route Notion state reconciliation through Make

lessons.reason: Make HTTP SEO verification path was broken
lessons.rootCause: the verification transport was unreliable for the required public proof
lessons.fix: use bounded GitHub public HTTP title and canonical verification and return the result to Make

lessons.reason: portal regressions expected previous auth literals after persistent Supabase session restore changed behavior
lessons.rootCause: implementation and literal contract assertions changed in different commits, leaving related tests stale
lessons.fix: keep persistent Supabase auth and update all directly related contract tests in the same candidate

lessons.reason: PR became non-mergeable after parallel commits changed main during repair
lessons.rootCause: the repair branch stayed on an old merge base while main continued changing overlapping files
lessons.fix: refresh against current main; if overlap exists recreate the candidate from current main and reapply only validated deltas

lessons.reason: GitHub Actions is not permitted to create or approve pull requests (createPullRequest)
lessons.rootCause: repository or organization Actions policy disallowed GITHUB_TOKEN from creating pull requests even when the job token reported pull-requests write permission
lessons.fix: fail readiness closed until the policy is enabled and prove the result with an exact-main writer-created candidate PR plus immutable shadow evidence

lessons.reason: writer-created candidate PR produced action_required follow-up workflows with no runnable shadow job
lessons.rootCause: a pull request created by GITHUB_TOKEN is not a reliable recursive trigger for subsequent Actions workflows
lessons.fix: after candidate PR creation explicitly dispatch the read-only writer shadow workflow with exact PR identity

lessons.reason: shadow identity validation rejected PR_BASE_SHA_DRIFT
lessons.rootCause: the writer passed its source checkout SHA as base_sha while the candidate PR had main at a different base SHA
lessons.fix: read candidate PR base.sha, head.sha and head.ref from GitHub after PR creation and pass those exact values to shadow verification

lessons.reason: a changed regression test was either unclassified or classified into a lane whose command did not execute that test family
lessons.rootCause: delivery membership and lane execution patterns evolved separately
lessons.fix: co-change classifier prefixes and the lane test command; every changed regression path must be both classified and executed

lessons.reason: an external adapter could return green while evidence persistence used an optional or no-op writer
lessons.rootCause: audit persistence was injectable but not mandatory before declaring success
lessons.fix: fail closed unless persistent evidence is written successfully before returning GREEN

lessons.reason: parallel agents opened equivalent candidates for the same scope and could race or duplicate migrations
lessons.rootCause: independent lanes did not always consolidate identical or overlapping work before promotion
lessons.fix: compare scope/head/content, select one canonical candidate and close duplicates before merge

lessons.reason: writer parity compared the full base-to-head range and incorrectly included unrelated BRAIN commits outside the writer-owned output
lessons.rootCause: the parity engine treated repository history as writer scope instead of using the already verified writer changedFiles boundary
lessons.fix: validate writer-owned paths first, then generate and reverse the Git patch only for those declared files while ignoring unrelated concurrent history

lessons.reason: a retried verification PR kept checking out its original base SHA and therefore could not exercise a runtime fix merged later to main
lessons.rootCause: the verification workflow intentionally binds execution to github.event.pull_request.base.sha, which is immutable for the existing trigger PR unless the base itself is refreshed
lessons.fix: close stale verification triggers after a runtime fix and create a fresh trigger from current main before claiming the fix is exercised

lessons.reason: parity evidence writeback ignored newly created files because git diff --name-only does not include untracked files
lessons.rootCause: writeback validation inspected tracked diffs only
lessons.fix: derive the allowlisted change set from git status --porcelain and include tracked, renamed and untracked evidence

lessons.reason: Git 2.55 rejected a shortened push destination while the workflow ran on detached HEAD
lessons.rootCause: the workflow assumed shorthand destination refs were portable from detached HEAD
lessons.fix: push with an explicit HEAD:refs/heads/<branch> refspec

lessons.reason: BG196 reached BG169 but Make rejected state_json as both missing and unexpected
lessons.rootCause: runScenarioWithInputs requires subscenario inputs inside the data envelope rather than as loose top-level fields
lessons.fix: map subscenario inputs through the canonical data object and validate the envelope before execution

lessons.reason: repository/runtime code could be green while native GitHub main protection or another external platform control was disabled or unreadable
lessons.rootCause: internal CI health and external platform enforcement were conflated
lessons.fix: observe external controls separately and fail closed on false or unknown required controls; never infer platform enforcement from pipeline success

lessons.reason: a negative readiness test became stale when the production fixture legitimately advanced to 7/7 verified state
lessons.rootCause: the test encoded an expected historical production value instead of constructing its own negative scenario
lessons.fix: build isolated negative fixtures inside the test and derive readiness from evidence rather than hardcoded live-state assumptions

lessons.reason: individual writers and the shared shadow both dispatched central gates, creating duplicate verification paths
lessons.rootCause: handoff ownership was duplicated across writer-specific and shared workflows
lessons.fix: use one canonical writer-to-shadow route and let only the verified shared shadow hand off to central gates

lessons.reason: due social publication returned zero eligible candidates while expected channel outcomes were still missing
lessons.rootCause: substantively ready content retained stale release-state fields so deterministic publishers excluded it
lessons.fix: reconcile the due record; only when substantive QA is already proven restore release state safely, rerun idempotent native publishers, and verify external post IDs

lessons.reason: BG156 rejected BG184 escalation as INVALID_EVENT_ENVELOPE
lessons.rootCause: BG184 omitted required top-level type and source fields
lessons.fix: dispatch the canonical ERROR envelope with top-level type and source plus component, fingerprint and evidence fields

lessons.reason: Make connector returned account-connect 400
lessons.rootCause: connected account authorization was unavailable and could not be repaired safely in-agent
lessons.fix: mark only the Make-dependent route BLOCKED_HARD_BOUNDARY, do not alter OAuth or credentials, continue independent safe work and retry the connector on later runs

lessons.reason: git pull --rebase failed because tracked generated seo-rapport.md remained dirty
lessons.rootCause: the workflow committed seo-status.json but left generated seo-rapport.md modified before rebase
lessons.fix: restore generated seo-rapport.md in the worktree before pull/rebase while preserving the intended seo-status writeback

lessons.reason: atomic ledger helper returned technical success while skipping new learning events
lessons.rootCause: dedupe checked a hardcoded historical PR139 marker instead of the incoming event fingerprint
lessons.fix: dedupe exclusively on stable event fingerprint and verify the actual append/write outcome before success

lessons.reason: Netlify production was ready but its commit_ref lagged the latest releasable main
lessons.rootCause: deploy readiness was treated separately from exact release identity reconciliation
lessons.fix: the Production Promotion Guardian reconciles latest releasable main to exact production commit_ref, allows bounded auto-deploy grace, triggers the safe deploy path if needed, then verifies smoke, regression, security and protected metrics

lessons.reason: technical success or zero work could be treated as green while required business or system outcome evidence was absent
lessons.rootCause: run status and intended outcome were conflated
lessons.fix: materialize due outcomes as obligations and allow green only with policy-valid evidence; otherwise remain MISSED_OBLIGATION or RECOVERING, or use an explicit valid hard boundary

lessons.reason: a RED-first development test was committed directly to the unprotected default branch before its matching fix existed
lessons.rootCause: native GitHub main protection is still an external hard boundary and development discipline relied on after-the-fact CI instead of candidate-only change isolation
lessons.fix: perform RED/GREEN TDD and all development mutations on an isolated candidate branch; execute the relevant gates there and let only the canonical exact-SHA BG169 promotion authority update production main

lessons.reason: a new component can run while missing from Brain governance, health, learning or cost projection
lessons.rootCause: component registration and cost membership were treated as post-launch follow-up instead of delivery completion criteria
lessons.fix: auto-register every new component before production and require registry plus cost/dashboard membership in the delivery gates

lessons.reason: missing provider usage can be misreported as numeric zero
lessons.rootCause: absence of metering evidence was conflated with measured zero usage
lessons.fix: represent missing counters as UNMETERED and connect each AI adapter to the request-idempotent provider usage ledger

lessons.reason: a READY deploy can belong to a different commit than the promoted candidate
lessons.rootCause: deploy readiness and exact deploy identity were verified independently
lessons.fix: require READY plus commit_ref equal to verified production SHA and independent production readback before PRODUCTION_GREEN

lessons.reason: private noindex authentication pages can fail irrelevant public SEO/site-chrome rules
lessons.rootCause: public content and private auth surfaces shared one scanner scope
lessons.fix: classify route scope first; private auth pages use auth/security regressions instead of public SEO layout requirements

lessons.reason: a remote mutation can target an unverified or unauthorized git remote
lessons.rootCause: local remote configuration was trusted without connector/account evidence
lessons.fix: verify repository and actor through the authorized GitHub connector and perform remote writes only through the proven route

lessons.reason: a required chat lesson can be present while its concrete prevention is not actively enforced
lessons.rootCause: required lesson and required prevention collections evolved independently
lessons.fix: fail closed on new required lessons without explicit prevention mapping and require every active prevention rule to resolve to PROVEN learning

lessons.reason: final BG169 production persistence used a current_main_sha that had already been superseded by parallel main drift
lessons.rootCause: current main was read before production verification and reused after additional commits landed
lessons.fix: re-read main immediately before final production persistence; if it moved, reconcile production against the new exact main and never reuse the stale SHA as final evidence

lessons.reason: HTTP acceptance or request success was treated as execution proof without independent downstream completion evidence
lessons.rootCause: transport acknowledgement and executed production state were conflated
lessons.fix: require accepted plus executed authority/candidate revision/verified_at evidence or exact production readback before success

lessons.reason: Make quota, pause, or unavailable capacity blocked the production handoff while the route could otherwise appear healthy
lessons.rootCause: platform capacity was not treated as a hard production boundary
lessons.fix: expose current capacity state and block promotion until fresh evidence reports available capacity

lessons.reason: client-side caching reduced UI reads but did not reduce Make source executions or operations
lessons.rootCause: cache optimization was measured at the client instead of the paid source-call boundary
lessons.fix: optimize source calls and polling cadence and prove operation reduction at the Make/provider boundary

lessons.reason: a state-changing write was used to discover whether a branch or resource existed
lessons.rootCause: discovery and mutation were conflated
lessons.fix: use read/search/get for branch and capability discovery and fail closed before any write when identity is unresolved

lessons.reason: a requiring chat-learning contract test landed without its canonical checkpoint or learning artifact
lessons.rootCause: checkpoint persistence and the test requiring it changed independently
lessons.fix: co-change canonical chat checkpoint or learning artifact with the requiring contract test in one candidate and verify both together

lessons.reason: a partial GitHub contents replacement temporarily truncated a test file during repair
lessons.rootCause: the contents API replaces the complete blob, but a fragment was sent as though it were a patch
lessons.fix: read the full current file, transform only the intended target, write the complete result, then verify the final diff before promotion

lessons.reason: file-level non-overlap appeared safe while newer main changed the same delivery contract through different files
lessons.rootCause: path overlap was treated as contract identity even though declared semantic contracts span files
lessons.fix: check declared and semantic contract overlap in addition to file overlap and rebuild only on same-contract drift

lessons.reason: a fresh ready PR on the same Git head could have reused success evidence bound to its predecessor PR identity
lessons.rootCause: head SHA identity and pull-request event identity were conflated
lessons.fix: after ready-PR recreation rerun identity-bound BRAIN verification for the new PR number while preserving the exact tested head

lessons.reason: two independently correct repair PRs remained red because each gate required the other fix
lessons.rootCause: file-level repair independence was mistaken for gate independence and created a cyclic readiness dependency
lessons.fix: when repair gate dependencies form a cycle, consolidate the minimal proven fixes on current main into one candidate

lessons.reason: merge acknowledgement could have been treated as final completion without proving the materialized main state
lessons.rootCause: repository mutation success, main materialization, and post-merge CI were conflated
lessons.fix: read main after merge, verify the expected merge SHA and canonical content, then require applicable push-triggered CI before completion

lessons.reason: a closed PR whose head was force-pushed or recreated could not be reopened and its surviving branch had diverged far behind current main
lessons.rootCause: historical PR identity was treated as the recovery authority before reconciling the intended fix against current main
lessons.fix: compare surviving head to current main first; retire stale recovery when the fix is already present, otherwise reconstruct only the minimal proven delta from current main

lessons.reason: Python CodeQL used run-id fallback concurrency so same-ref runs could not supersede stale work
lessons.rootCause: github.run_id made every push concurrency group unique even with cancel-in-progress enabled
lessons.fix: key CodeQL concurrency by stable workflow plus PR number/ref and keep cancel-in-progress true

lessons.reason: an authoritative exact-SHA post-merge security run could be reported as a final pending-status handoff
lessons.rootCause: terminal-delivery guidance did not explicitly classify active post-merge CodeQL as internal execution state
lessons.fix: retain delivery ownership until the newest relevant exact-SHA security run is terminal or an evidenced hard boundary exists

lessons.reason: a client response transport interruption can make an active delivery appear abandoned
lessons.rootCause: chat transport state was not explicitly separated from repository and delivery terminal state
lessons.fix: resume the canonical branch or PR and newest exact head on the next executable turn and continue to the normal terminal contract

lessons.reason: Production exact-source fallback was mistakenly retried as build lag although the Supabase OIDC bridge could not resolve a Netlify connection in the scoped Composio project
lessons.rootCause: Composio project-scoped deployment key did not reveal an ACTIVE authorized netlify_mcp account. The bridge's HTTP 420 maps any unavailable account to the not_public error, without proving the exact missing binding
lessons.fix: Classify HTTP 420 as non-retryable authorization boundary, preserve exact source evidence and incident owner, restore provider/Composio project visibility through an approved service/team connection and independently verify production readback

lessons.reason: writing a file under .github/workflows returned 403 although a Workflows permission was granted
lessons.rootCause: a fine-grained token with only Workflows read/write cannot write workflow files; GitHub requires Contents write as well
lessons.fix: grant Contents and Workflows read/write together; ask GitHub which permission is missing via the x-accepted-github-permissions response header instead of guessing

lessons.reason: personal access tokens were pasted into chats and then used in shell commands on three occasions in August 2026
lessons.rootCause: credentials were handed over as chat text instead of being placed in a vault or Actions secret
lessons.fix: never ask for, accept, repeat or store a token in chat text; use the connected GitHub account or a vault/secret, and tell the owner to revoke any token that was pasted

lessons.reason: the weekblog trigger returned 401 for days while the scenario dashboard showed zero errors
lessons.rootCause: a fine-grained token had expired and an error handler ignored the failure, so only a side mail revealed it
lessons.fix: never ignore an authentication error; every credential with an expiry date gets a reminder before it lapses and every failure path reports what failed

lessons.reason: unauthenticated GitHub API calls returned 403 after about 60 requests per hour and raw.githubusercontent.com served stale content after a commit
lessons.rootCause: the unauthenticated API has a per-IP hourly limit and the raw host is cached
lessons.fix: read files via raw.githubusercontent.com or the authenticated connector; verify a fresh commit through the contents API with ref=main, never through the raw host

lessons.reason: merge returned 405 required status check is expected although the check on the branch was green
lessons.rootCause: branch protection is strict and the branch was behind main, so the green check did not apply to the merge result
lessons.fix: call update-branch on the pull request, wait for the required check to rerun on the new head, then retry the merge

lessons.reason: enabling auto-merge through GraphQL returned FORBIDDEN
lessons.rootCause: Allow auto-merge was disabled in the repository settings
lessons.fix: check that auto-merge is enabled before planning around it; if it is off, report that the owner must enable it and continue polling instead

lessons.reason: contents API writes failed repeatedly with 409 conflicts
lessons.rootCause: brain agents commit to the repository continuously, so the file sha read earlier was already stale
lessons.fix: write through a multi-file commit with base_branch or the Git Data API (blobs, tree with base_tree, commit, ref); never retry the contents API in a loop

lessons.reason: creating a branch named koppelingen/api returned 422
lessons.rootCause: a branch named koppelingen already existed and git refs cannot be both a file and a directory
lessons.fix: list existing refs first and use flat branch names without a slash after an existing branch name

lessons.reason: a branch and pull request #988 already existed a minute before the agent committed, producing a duplicate commit
lessons.rootCause: inventory was not refreshed immediately before creating the branch while another process worked on the same change
lessons.fix: search open pull requests by head_branch and for the same files immediately before creating a branch; reuse the existing owner instead of creating a second candidate

lessons.reason: check-run lookups by branch name returned nothing or the wrong runs
lessons.rootCause: the check-runs endpoint needs the full commit sha and returns skipped and neutral runs next to real ones
lessons.fix: always query check-runs by the full head sha and filter on conclusion; a neutral Netlify Pages changed run is not a failure

lessons.reason: the Required workflow stayed red after the pull request body was corrected
lessons.rootCause: a body edit does not emit a new pull_request event for the Required workflow
lessons.fix: close the pull request, wait five seconds and reopen it, or rerun the failed jobs on the same head; never claim green from an edited body

lessons.reason: a new test file never ran in CI and a new file in an unlisted folder turned every delivery check red with unclassified delivery path
lessons.rootCause: CI runs explicit test lists per lane and config/brain-delivery-system.json classifies every changed path
lessons.fix: register every new test in a lane workflow and give new files a name that matches an existing lane prefix instead of editing the delivery configuration

lessons.reason: creating a Supabase preview branch failed with GitHub branch not found
lessons.rootCause: the git branch name was typed incompletely in the dashboard (a date suffix was cut off)
lessons.fix: copy the exact branch name from GitHub, and delete the preview branch after merge because it bills per hour

lessons.reason: a session with only anonymous read access reported on open pull requests and failing checks it could not see
lessons.rootCause: pull requests, check-runs and protection details need authenticated access; anonymous reads show only public files
lessons.fix: without an authenticated GitHub link make no claim about pull request or check state; report the gap and ask for the link or the list

lessons.reason: checks went red with Hash Sum mismatch although no code had changed
lessons.rootCause: CI installed Google Chrome from an apt source that regularly serves inconsistent package hashes
lessons.fix: install Chromium only through tools/ci/install-chromium.sh, which removes that apt source and retries three times

lessons.reason: A Supabase migration applied outside Git made repository and provider diverge
lessons.rootCause: Provider state and supabase/migration-history.lock.json were changed separately; production showed 805 migrations against 801 in the lock and BRAIN ran red 26 of 40 times between 2 and 5 November
lessons.fix: Add the migration file and its lock entry in the same change; a migration applied outside Git always needs a provider readback by the migration owner; never edit a test expectation to turn a check green

lessons.reason: A blog stayed GENERATED without any error
lessons.rootCause: approved_at was empty and the export refuses unapproved content; setting approved_at directly in the database would bypass the approval gate
lessons.fix: Approve content only through record_content_publication_state; never write approved_at directly

lessons.reason: Withdrawing a blog did not hold
lessons.rootCause: powerhouse-blog-queue moved FAILED back to GENERATED, so a plain status change was undone
lessons.fix: Reject durably with evidence.veto = {active: true, reason}; verify by reading the row back after the next queue run

lessons.reason: A SQL stage was counted as an agent action
lessons.rootCause: Process output was read as an agent run; a SQL stage is SQL_PROCESS, not AGENT_EXECUTED
lessons.fix: Claim an agent action only with agent_id, skill_version and a before and after; use the status ladder REGISTERED, WIRED, JOB_ACTIVE, EXECUTED, PROVIDER_VERIFIED, OUTCOME_PROVEN, LEARNING_APPLIED and never claim a higher step than the evidence shows

lessons.reason: Row cleanup in production data cannot be undone
lessons.rootCause: Deleting or rewriting rows has no rollback; cleanup was attempted before the owner agreed
lessons.fix: Propose first, wait for the owner's yes, then write and read back the result; production migrations and spend stay with the owner

lessons.reason: Control Plane saw no Supabase URL
lessons.rootCause: Netlify Functions context has BG_PORTAL_EU_SUPABASE_URL, not SUPABASE_URL
lessons.fix: Check which config keys Netlify Functions actually expose before reading one; never add a new secret or a second source

lessons.reason: A READY deploy was read as proof of the outcome
lessons.rootCause: READY shows the published version for the exact commit, not that the change works for the customer
lessons.fix: Treat READY on the exact commit as one link; keep browser or provider readback and the outcome as separate evidence; a 401 on an admin-only endpoint without an admin-JWT 200 is unproven, not green

lessons.reason: A LinkedIn connection was ACTIVE but the backend could not publish
lessons.rootCause: Nine connections were ACTIVE and none healthy because tokens were revoked on 3 and 30 October; the server key saw 11 accounts that all returned REVOKED_ACCESS_TOKEN
lessons.fix: ACTIVE is not proof: before publishing check the exact server project, the account, its scopes and a LINKEDIN_GET_MY_INFO readback; company posting also needs the organisation URN, ADMINISTRATOR role and read rights on the same connection

lessons.reason: A Gmail call failed with no connection in the server project on 30 September
lessons.rootCause: An id from the chat environment was used instead of a real connected_account_id of the server project
lessons.fix: Every outgoing run first checks the exact server project and a real ACTIVE connected_account_id with its user_id

lessons.reason: The wrong Instagram account was measured
lessons.rootCause: Eight connections point to @arthurprinsen and aliases containing the company name are misleading; the company account is id 28537384955950341
lessons.fix: Every measurement records account id and username; LinkedIn company figures come from Windsor linkedin_organic account 18234216, not from OAuth that lacks the admin scope

lessons.reason: Buffer returned 429 with a retry-after of about three days on 29 October and again on 6 November
lessons.rootCause: The client rate limit was reached; looping or adding a second route does not help and Make is abolished
lessons.fix: Respect retry-after, do not loop, add no second publishing route, report the blocker and repair the existing line; Buffer-Instagram counts as available only after a successful call with a read-back result

lessons.reason: Windsor sync said ok but the data was old
lessons.rootCause: WINDSOR_API_KEY was missing from the vault and the sync reused an earlier readback
lessons.fix: An ok with fallback is not a fresh measurement; always record the fetch date; setting the key is the owner's task

lessons.reason: The GA4 sync reported ok but wrote zero measurements (six syncs on 31 October)
lessons.rootCause: Empty provider reports were counted as success; a 403 on property 546874601 meant the canonical service account was not authorised
lessons.fix: Test provider observation, non-empty rows and source attribution per metric date; on 403 check the exact account binding and never mask authorisation; INSUFFICIENT_DATA is a valid outcome and never claimed as significant

lessons.reason: bg-gsc-sync and bg-zoekwoordkansen showed VEROUDERD after 74 hours
lessons.rootCause: A weekly job was judged with a daily freshness threshold; the root cause of the NOOIT_BEWEZEN counts is still unknown
lessons.fix: Use a cadence-aware health check and never hide a missed or failed run; find and record the root cause before declaring these jobs healthy

lessons.reason: DataForSEO task 40101 or 40102 was read as an error
lessons.rootCause: No search results is valid emptiness at HTTP 200 with status code 20000
lessons.fix: Only 40101 and 40102 are EMPTY, every other status is an error; payment, subscription, auth and rate-limit errors are never retried to force green; use short Dutch search phrases and record a partial result honestly

lessons.reason: Twelve companies were wrongly rejected as having no own website
lessons.rootCause: HTTP 432 plan usage limit was read as no results
lessons.fix: A provider error stops the run with an alarm and is never written as an empty result; bg-bedrijfsnieuws (version 12, read 6 November) throws TAVILY_<status> on any non-ok response and records a failed bg_bewijs, so it does not share this blind spot

lessons.reason: Instagram published nothing since 3 October with MEDIA_ASSET_REQUIRED
lessons.rootCause: An agent session that nobody starts is a stopped loop; no cron starts the producer session
lessons.fix: Every loop has an owner and a starter; check scheduled runs per day, not only green, because the daily blog workflow ran once per about five hours instead of hourly

lessons.reason: The personal LinkedIn post of 6 November was not published
lessons.rootCause: The 07:00 UTC deadline was missed and EXACT_PROVIDER_PUBLICATION_PROOF_MISSING was returned
lessons.fix: Establish the external effect first and never republish blind; never bypass the quality gate or send manually outside the existing chain

lessons.reason: The START HIER page could not be read in one go
lessons.rootCause: The page exceeds 288,000 characters and every session adds a section at the top; a fetch is cut at 100,000
lessons.fix: Read only the top part and follow links; summarise old sections into an archive page without discarding facts; correct the old status of the same item on every update and attach evidence to each claim

lessons.reason: five Dutch blog blocks were reported as missing translations by the static i18n cache check on five consecutive main merges even though a patch for the same blog existed
lessons.rootCause: the translation patch keyed the text as separate sentences while the build looks up the final page blocks, so the keys never matched after the blog text was edited or segmented differently
lessons.fix: add the exact missing build keys to a config/bg-static-i18n-en.d patch using the existing sentence translations; after any public text change regenerate or verify the patch against the build output (STATIC_I18N_CACHE_MISSING lists the exact keys)

lessons.reason: an edit to a site .html file or to assets/kop.css disappeared on the next deploy, or a block that was removed from the page kept coming back
lessons.rootCause: the HTML in the repository is generator input; netlify.toml runs the tools/ generators on every deploy and they rewrite the pages
lessons.fix: start at netlify.toml and tools/ (for example tools/bouw-v18-views.mjs and tools/v18-modules.mjs) and change the generator; search the pages only after the generators are understood

lessons.reason: a change in index.html did not survive a build
lessons.rootCause: tools/bouw-v18-production-core.mjs unpacks a hash-checked payload and overwrites index.html on every build
lessons.fix: change the homepage through an extra html.replace in that build file, not in index.html

lessons.reason: a hand-made page lost its header, menu or top bar, or a generated view overwrote a hand-made page
lessons.rootCause: the page sat outside the generator, on the uniforme-schil exclusion list or without a main element, or its view name was left in the generator view lists
lessons.fix: before expecting the shared shell, check the generator view lists (tools/v18-views-lijst.mjs, tools/bouw-losse-paginas.mjs), the exclusion list in tools/uniforme-schil.mjs and that the page has a main element; never add a hand-made page back to the view lists

lessons.reason: all standalone content pages rendered white on desktop while the text was in the DOM (PR #1323)
lessons.rootCause: scoopCss() in tools/bouw-v18-chrome.mjs flattened a scrollbar selector into .inhoud-body{width:12px} inside a desktop media query, shrinking the content column to 12px
lessons.fix: measure the ancestor geometry with getBoundingClientRect in headless Chrome before changing paint, opacity, visibility or overflow; a guard that forces visibility is not a fix until the cause is measured

lessons.reason: nearly every page carried the Over ons WebPage schema and up to eleven duplicate data blocks (PR #1378)
lessons.rootCause: tools/site-shell/apply-shell.mjs uses over-ons.html as the shell and copied its JSON-LD along
lessons.fix: never copy shell JSON-LD to pages, de-duplicate each page own blocks and refuse a WebPage or BlogPosting whose URL differs from the canonical

lessons.reason: hygiene / admission failed with LEARNING_CANONICALIZATION_BLOCKED because the evaluation tests failed on Cannot find package parse5 (PR #5494)
lessons.rootCause: the canonical learning evaluation in admission runs without installed npm packages, so tests that import them cannot pass there
lessons.fix: name only dependency-free tests in a learning record evaluation block (historical_replay, shadow, canary); mention dependency-needing tests as evidence instead

lessons.reason: two tests demanded opposite behavior after a rebuild (buildLegacyUrl, ensureNativeRange and window.scrollTo, three times)
lessons.rootCause: a new test contract was added without retiring the old one in the same change
lessons.fix: when a test is red, first look for a second test that demands the opposite; retire or rewrite the old contract in the same change as the rebuild

lessons.reason: six tests in one day failed on the first rewording although the code was correct
lessons.rootCause: the tests asserted literal source text or marketing copy instead of behavior
lessons.fix: a test asserts the outcome, never the promise; do not target section ids or marketing copy

lessons.reason: a bulk change updated 66 pages but left the canonical header in .github/ untouched
lessons.rootCause: glob.glob with ** does not descend into folders that start with a dot, so .github/ was skipped
lessons.fix: include dot folders explicitly in bulk file operations and check that .github/canoniek/kop.html moves with the pages

lessons.reason: a new menu item failed the SEO check on every page
lessons.rootCause: the SEO check compares .github/canoniek/kop.html with the menu bar of every page, so the canonical file is leading
lessons.fix: add every new menu item to .github/canoniek/kop.html in the same change

lessons.reason: a pull request showed unstable or a preview check went red without a code fault
lessons.rootCause: the Netlify Pages changed run always concludes neutral, and the asset-verification step can run before the Netlify deploy is ready
lessons.fix: only the required checks (test, hygiene / admission, CodeQL) decide; prove the diff is not the cause and rerun the failed job instead of editing the code

lessons.reason: pull requests and branches were created for work another session already had open: #988 on 3 September, and #5493, #5495 and #5502 on 6 November touching the same lessons files
lessons.rootCause: no search for an open pull request on the same head branch or the same changed files was done immediately before creating the branch and again before opening the pull request
lessons.fix: search open pull requests by head branch and by changed file path right before creating a branch and again before opening the pull request; extend or explicitly supersede the existing one instead of opening a second

lessons.reason: three sessions edited delivery-failure-lessons.json and delivery-prevention-rules.json on 6 November and one pull request was left dirty against main for hours
lessons.rootCause: no single owner was named per root cause, so parallel sessions appended to the same files and the slowest pull request conflicted with the others
lessons.fix: before adding lessons, rules or triggers search open pull requests and branches by topic and by these file paths; if one exists, extend it or supersede it explicitly after confirming it is stale, and name one owner per root cause

lessons.reason: five of seven recent daily blog articles carry markdown list syntax inside paragraphs and section-sized headings live, and the same malformed text nodes later broke the static i18n cache check on main
lessons.rootCause: the markdown-to-HTML step turned a whole block starting with a heading marker into one heading and wrote text-plus-list blocks as a single paragraph; only all-list and bold-first-line blocks were recognised, and nothing checked the rendered markup
lessons.fix: treat a heading as its first line only, render mixed text and list lines as separate paragraph and list elements, and fail closed before writing the page when a heading or paragraph still contains markdown list lines or a heading is section-sized

lessons.reason: the daily blog candidate was rejected by hygiene / admission with INTEGRATION_BUNDLE_CLOSURE_INCOMPLETE and the required check test stayed red
lessons.rootCause: the workflow stages the English cache patch config/bg-static-i18n-en.d/powerhouse-blog-<date>.json, which was not listed in runtimeClosurePathPrefixes, so it counted as a material change needing Brain learning, ledger and documentation files
lessons.fix: add the patch prefix to runtimeClosurePathPrefixes in config/powerhouse-integration-bundle-v1.json and keep a test that reads the git add paths from the workflow and requires each to be covered

lessons.reason: the BRAIN backend lane went red after the daily blog merged with STATIC_I18N_CACHE_INCOMPLETE although the PR checks were green
lessons.rootCause: the daily blog workflow translates the production transform chain view of the article (text fragments) but the BRAIN cache tests validate the committed HTML (whole blocks); the two views have different segment keys and only the CI log of the failing lane shows the missing keys
lessons.fix: after the production pass, run a second prepare pass on the clean committed tree (build-localized-routes --prepare-cache) and validate fail-closed, in both candidate steps of the workflow, and keep a dependency-free test for the step order

lessons.reason: the required check test failed on every pull request (including the daily blog PR 5525) with spawnSync git ENOBUFS in tools/build/artifact-id.mjs, so no PR could merge
lessons.rootCause: node execFileSync has a default maxBuffer of 1 MiB and git ls-files -s on this repository (about 10.7k files) is about 1.2 MB, so the build step died as soon as the file index grew past 1 MiB; nothing warned before the limit was crossed
lessons.fix: set maxBuffer explicitly on the git ls-files calls in tools/build/artifact-id.mjs and tests/delivery-test-coverage-guard.test.mjs and pin it with a dependency-free test that also proves the 1 MiB default fails

lessons.reason: the required check test was red on every pull request after the preflight step npm install exited 1 within seconds, hidden by --silent
lessons.rootCause: root dependency ffmpeg-static runs node install.js as a postinstall and downloads a binary from GitHub releases; that download returned HTTP 504 (reproduced locally with npm 10.9.2). The same incident was fixed on 5 Nov only in lane-backend.yml, so the identical npm install in required-test.yml kept the failure; --silent hid the real error
lessons.fix: preflight installs with --ignore-scripts like the backend lane; the Netlify build parity install does the same (the pin in brain-composable-release-control-plane.test.mjs now accepts the flag); a dependency-free test pins preflight, parity and the backend lane
